definitions.gloss: packed train; crowded train; train at full capacity
definitions.explanation: a train that is extremely crowded with passengers, typically during rush hours in urban Japan

FORMS:
⟦{満員|まんいん}→満員：07584_manin⟧ (full capacity) + ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧ (train) → full-capacity train

JAPANESE RUSH HOUR:
During peak commuting hours (⟦{通勤|つうきん}ラッシュ→通勤ラッシュ：08486_tsuukinrasshu⟧) in major cities like Tokyo and Osaka, trains can reach 180-200% of their designed capacity.
